summary: This table presents a financial performance summary for a company, comparing key metrics for the periods ending June 30, 2025, June 30, 2024, and March 31, 2025. Key metrics include revenues, gross profit, operating expenses, operating profit, and net profit, with growth percentages calculated year-over-year (YoY) and quarter-over-quarter (QoQ). Notably, revenues increased from 39,315 in June 2024 to 42,279 in June 2025, reflecting a 7.5% growth YoY. Operating profit showed a slight decline in margin percentage from 21.1% to 20.8% YoY, while net profit before non-controlling interests rose to 6,924, marking an 8.6% increase YoY. The table also includes earnings per share (EPS) figures, indicating a consistent growth trend across the reported periods.
